title: VideoManifest
description: Canonical identity and immutable raw-video location. Legacy probe fields may accompany, but never replace, storage_uri, duration_ms, and exact fps_str.

storage_uri.description: Stable raw-video URI. Use file:// for local development and r2:// or s3:// for object storage; do not store signed query credentials.

oneOf.description: Absolute file URI with an optional localhost/UNC authority.
S3-compatible bucket URI with a non-empty, safely percent-encoded object key.

fps_str.description: Exact positive FPS fraction, retained without float rounding (for example 30000/1001).

frame_count.description: Exact decoded frame count when a full sequential decode has completed.

path.description: Legacy probe/local-cache hint; storage_uri remains the canonical source identity.

duration_s.description: Legacy probe convenience value; duration_ms is canonical.

fps.description: Legacy probe convenience value; fps_str is canonical.

n_frames_est.description: Legacy probe estimate; it must not be treated as an exact frame count.
